statusDefinitions.implemented: Executable source exists for the explicitly bounded scope.
statusDefinitions.connected: Exact identifiers and artifacts join neighboring executed components.
statusDefinitions.executed: The retained evidence records actual local work.
statusDefinitions.independently-checked-same-controller: Different reference implementation and/or reviewing agent under one research controller.
statusDefinitions.live-read-verified: Point-in-time trusted-provider observation, no transaction or authority granted.
statusDefinitions.not-demonstrated: Required matching evidence is absent; ambition remains separate.
statusDefinitions.compiled-frozen-visually-reviewed: Exact local publication artifacts are frozen; all 29 rendered pages have visual signoff. This does not establish public-site deployment.
statusDefinitions.paper-pr-open-not-deployed: A normal paper pull request is open with its reported classifier result; no merge or public deployment is asserted.

authority: No financial, mainnet, production or inherited descendant authority is created by this index.
evidenceHashPolicy: SHA-256 identifies the exact observed file. Directory entries are navigational. Publication PDF, complete single-file TeX, source ZIP and source manifest are frozen to the release receipt. Any later byte change requires a new identity and applicable revalidation. Hash equality is not semantic proof, signature or permission.

claims.claim: Requested source editions, actual document locations and retained earlier failures are inventoried.
claims.scope: Primary-source audit; publication ideas are distinguished from implemented behavior.
limitations: Source text does not establish that proposals were deployed or commercially successful.

claims.claim: Actual existing APIs from all four repositories execute with preserved mission bindings.
claims.scope: Current pinned source composition and fixed Fleet worker/checker functions.
limitations: Installed native Fleet host qualification, open enterprise receivers and held Harness objectives remain outside this path.
The original runtime audit predates the separate EVM join and retains its original settlement:not-connected field.

claims.claim: A fresh fixed parent-to-successor run joins computation, independent receipts, four source APIs and both local settlements.
claims.scope: One connected local driver with two semantic missions.
limitations: Computed artifacts precede local posting; this is not a JobMarket-award-triggered installed Fleet dispatcher.
No production permission, real token movement or external customer demand follows.

claims.claim: The final joined-evidence verifier rejects targeted input, graph, output, proof and transaction-history mutations, and setup verifies actual required dependencies.
claims.scope: Eight saved-evidence regression cases and read-only setup readiness; original scientific candidate, criteria and EVM artifacts remain unchanged.
limitations: Initial input rebinding and empty lifecycle acceptance are preserved as defects, together with an intermediate missing Fleet graph-digest check.
Driver child-failure capture correction was source-reviewed; no fresh forced failure was run solely to exercise that logging branch.
Readiness covers relevant Fleet runtime and all local EVM dependencies; it does not qualify unrelated Fleet development tools.

claims.claim: The defined Identify and six-function loop and named Ascension roles have explicit module/input/output/cost coverage.
claims.scope: Seven instrumented stages; eight named roles; five contract controllers plus finite organizational adapters.
limitations: Insight, Sovereign/Business and Architect names do not imply execution of the full historical autonomous agent constellations.
No learned venture search, beyond-human foresight or unrestricted source invention.

claims.claim: Thirty-eight distinct existing Alpha local contract/native tests pass on unchanged main source.
claims.scope: 33 core contract tests plus five Python/native adapter tests.
limitations: Existing allocation fixture tests are separate from the new graph experiment.
Passing suite totals do not establish individual coverage of all 119 ABI public signatures or a formal security audit.

claims.claim: Five code hashes and 28 read-only getter values match the retained Ethereum deployment projection.
claims.scope: Trusted-provider observation at one finalized block; no chain transaction.
limitations: No exhaustive participant admission, external token/ENS/controller authority or operational deployment audit.
Direct source contracts are not proxy-upgrade contracts; external dependencies remain separately unverified.

claims.claim: Fresh official explorer ABI structures match local compiled interfaces for all five contracts.
claims.scope: Semantic ABI comparison on exact observed sources.
limitations: Historical raw serialization SHA fields remain unreconciled; no historical raw-byte ABI match is asserted.

claims.claim: Both exact new artifacts settle through all five unchanged contracts in one local chain with actual parent-child seed relation.
claims.scope: Disposable unforked chain 31337; actual mock-token and emitted contract events.
limitations: Standalone child receipt duplicates the embedded child; count once.
No mainnet activation, real financial transfer, sale or inferred IP/equity.
The new public capsule is a commitment, not encrypted content.

claims.claim: Actual artifact admission controls and separate-agent handcrafted semantic controls pass.
claims.scope: 17 actual-byte controls (two positive plus 15 negative/mutation controls) and 19 handcrafted checker controls.
limitations: No EVM transactions in the gate control script.
Separately implemented and reviewed under one controller; no institutional independence claim.
A digest or accepted:true flag alone is insufficient; frozen checker re-execution and complete receipt equality are required.

claims.claim: The five contracts preserve distinct verified benefits and actual access semantics.
claims.scope: 119 public ABI signatures classified for direct, transitive or unexecuted local use and specific live reads.
limitations: Access needs ENS/wrapped ownership plus admission.
NovaSeed ERC-721 ownership is not IP ownership or equity.
RiskOracle attestations are not calibrated predictions.
Any account may declare its own availability; Validator eligibility/stake are checked later when locked.
JobMarket result/evidence commitments do not implement the semantic evaluator.
MARK reserve lots and funding do not establish economic value.
Manager USDC6 remains separate from the AGIALPHA18 route.

claims.claim: The final criteria and mission bank were frozen before first scoring, with a disclosed prospective bank correction.
claims.scope: 48 finite authored missions: 16 weighted-demand, 16 impact, eight flat and eight invalid.
limitations: Initial all-reachable Boolean bank was weak and is preserved.
Task bytes were outside the proposer source namespace under instructions, not protected by hostile OS isolation.
Released task-bank reproductions are not newly blinded.

claims.claim: Scoped reuse reduces repeated generic module qualification from 1,600 to 64 cases, preserving full-quality decisions and fresh checks.
claims.scope: Three 48-mission repetitions per variant; six predeclared variants and one explicitly supplementary variant.
limitations: 96% describes generic qualification cases, not all validation, CPU, dollars or human effort.
Initial self-parent metadata defect preserved; v2 is disclosed known-bank confirmation.
Finite scoped tests are not formal implementation proof or general AGI evidence.

claims.claim: The measured local load envelope accepts 672 of 672 missions across six settings with two repeats.
claims.scope: One or two Node worker threads; volumes 8, 32 and 128; startup and queue waiting included.
limitations: Execution-volume experiment on one host, not physical Fleet scaling or expanded opportunity coverage.
Dollar cost per accepted result and complete human oversight remain unknown.
Two load repetitions are descriptive, not production reliability certification.

claims.claim: Queue/checker controls preserve failures, require explicit recovery and enforce the tested permissions and ceilings.
claims.scope: Nine research queue/checker cases and eight scientific admission cases.
limitations: Not the held native/site probes.
No hostile process isolation or universal cancellation guarantee.

claims.claim: The supplied direct specialist wins final median wall time at the same accepted quality.
claims.scope: Known-bank confirmation, three timing repeats.
limitations: Supplied deterministic specialist is not a recruited human expert.
Runtime timing depends on environment; no statistical universal ranking or optimality claim.

claims.claim: Capability construction broadens accepted coverage from 8 to 40 of the 40 valid declared tasks; new Boolean semantics transfer shared machinery.
claims.scope: Finite authored population under the same declared operation/hash/time bounds.
limitations: This is supported algorithm composition from supplied modules, not discovery of a commercial market.
The illustrative mixed-output successor was chosen after scoring; selection does not alter score denominators.

claims.claim: Assets and history can be exported/restored while descendants and changed contexts require fresh proof and authority.
claims.scope: Executable typed assets, history, independently checked results and empty current authority; local fixture permissions separately granted.
limitations: currentProof and authority are off-chain fields, not NovaSeed storage.
Symbolic Kahn/DFS strategy swap is tested; learned-model provider swap is unverified.
Production authority and hostile OS independence are not established.

claims.claim: No measured live profit, external firm offer, validated demand or complete monetary cost is established.
claims.scope: Economic status of the whole assignment, including authoring, failures and oversight.
limitations: Zero new paid services and zero runtime model calls do not make development free.
Mock token payouts, qualification counts, artifacts and quotes are not revenue or profit.
The technical threshold is not substituted for compelling external practical value.

claims.claim: Eleven checks pass on the final local bilingual interface, with responsive screenshots and actual interrupted/recovered execution.
claims.scope: New target http://127.0.0.1:8765/study/interface/ only; widths 1440, 390 and 320 pixels. Actual capability, module and job identifiers are displayed.
limitations: Original held targets were not attempted.
Scoped keyboard, reduced-motion and layout checks are not a formal WCAG audit.
Public deployment requires its own verified receipt.

claims.claim: The frozen 29-page scientific PDF, matching complete single-file LaTeX and publication source ZIP are supplied; all 29 rendered pages have visual signoff.
claims.scope: Frozen local publication with an isolated single-file compile, complete bibliography, four editable vector figures, source archive verification and every-page visual review.
limitations: Local publication completion does not establish public-site deployment, external demand, a sale or economic value.
The publication-source ZIP is separate from the full executable software/evidence companion.
Visual signoff is by the publication agent under the same research controller; it is not external peer review.

claims.claim: The frozen paper is submitted as normal open PR #4877 with a passing paper classifier; the separate software draft review is forthcoming.
claims.scope: Coordinating publisher submission, preserving existing review, CI, held actions and the distinction between passive paper and executable software changes.
limitations: Held Harness #4863/#4865 merge/review actions, Fleet review and four native/site probes remain unattempted.
Code, ZIP, SVG, bibliography and interface changes cannot be classified as passive paper-only work. The paper PR uses the permitted PDF and self-contained TeX path.
A passing classifier and open pull request do not complete review, merge or public-site publication.
Existing authorization and owning review requirements remain applicable.

unsupportedBroaderClaims: Guaranteed profit or universal mission completion
Validated external customer demand or a real sale
Institutionally independent evaluation or production validators
Installed Fleet host isolation or held Harness integration
Mainnet financial execution or production permission
New public-site or paper deployment before verified publication receipt
